claim: ORGAN 4 is the critic that judges a draft answer against THIS turn's evidence BEFORE it ships — the last gate between the mouth and the user. It is fully deterministic (substring / value-contradiction / heuristic; NO model on the critical path) so the whole organ is exercised model-free, and it never raises into a turn (a crashing gate fails OPEN). It catches the three companion-fatal failures and proves the good cases pass: (1) CONTRADICTION — the draft states a value for a known trait (a birthday, a name, a place) that conflicts with what the evidence holds for that same trait (telling you the WRONG birthday you taught it) -> override=True (suppress/regenerate); (2) UNSUPPORTED PERSONAL CLAIM — the draft asserts a hard personal specific (a date/name/contact) that is NOT in the evidence and NOT in the question (confabulation) -> override=True; (3) IGNORED KNOWN FACT — the symmetric partner: the question explicitly asks about a trait the evidence holds as a settled KNOWN fact, yet the draft DISCLAIMS it ('I don't have your birthday') or OMITS the value (the exact ~25% Spine failure) -> override=True, strictly gated on a KNOWN fact EXISTING so an honest 'I don't have that yet' on a genuine unknown is NEVER punished. A correct evidence-grounded answer, a claim grounded by the question or a real cap_note, a normal non-personal reply, and an honest disclaimer of a genuinely-unknown trait all PASS untouched. Evidence is accepted in EITHER substrate shape (canonical Memory dict OR raw LIRF row); garbage/None is dropped, never fatal.
owner: anima/organs/verifier.py (the model-free core: Verifier.verify / module-level verify() = the gate the turn calls post-draft; Verdict(ok/confidence/issues/override) = the output contract, override implies not ok; _normalise_evidence/_coerce_fact = shape-agnostic ingest of both substrate shapes; _values_conflict + _date_signature = format-aware contradiction (CHECK 1); _extract_claims + _question_grounds/_note_grounds + _HARD_PERSONAL_TRAITS/_NAME_TRAITS = unsupported-personal confabulation (CHECK 2); _asked_traits (routes on the shared memory_lirf._Q_TRAITS table) + _Fact.is_known (the [KNOWN] §1.3 bar) + _DISCLAIMER_RE + _draft_has_value = ignored-known-fact omission (CHECK 3); _score = confidence fold (CHECK 4); verify_observation = best-effort bus emit of the verdict for telemetry), anima/server.py (the live ENFORCEMENT seam in _turn: `from .organs.verifier import verify` -> verify(text, u.text, _evidence=Facts.load(name).about(SELF), cap_note=cap_note); an ignored_known_fact override drives REGENERATE-once-with-hard-binding then ship the spine.answer_from_fact deterministic floor so the KNOWN fact always appears; a confabulation override drives the honest-unknown floor; fully guarded so a verifier hiccup degrades to the original draft, never breaks a turn)

killer_test.name: verifier_flags_contradiction_confabulation_and_ignored_known_fact_passes_grounded
killer_test.setup: Pure + deterministic + offline (no model, no store mutation). The cert calls the SAME module-level anima.organs.verifier.verify() the server's _turn gate calls. SAFETY (must FLAG, override=True): (1) CONTRADICTION — evidence holds birthday 1990-06-11, the draft says 'Your birthday is June 14th!' -> override + issue 'contradiction' + confidence < 0.2; proven from BOTH a canonical Memory dict AND a raw LIRF row (shape-agnostic). (2) UNSUPPORTED PERSONAL CLAIM — empty evidence, the draft invents 'your birthday is March 3rd!' / a confabulated dog name -> override + issue 'unsupported_personal_claim'. (3) IGNORED KNOWN FACT — evidence holds a KNOWN birthday (September 14, active, conf 0.97), the question asks 'when's my birthday?', the draft disclaims ('I don't have your birthday saved') OR silently omits the value OR is an incoherent disclaimer-that-also-states-the-value -> override + issue 'ignored_known_fact:birthday'. GROUNDED (must PASS, override=False, ok=True): a correct 'Your birthday is June 11th' against the stored fact; the SAME date in a different spelling ('June 11, 1990'); a claim the user supplied in the question; a claim backed by a real cap_note; a normal non-personal reply (a joke); an honest disclaimer of a GENUINELY-UNKNOWN birthday (no KNOWN row -> rule inert); a known value stated across spellings (Sept 14 / 9/14 / the 14th). GUARDS: a CONTESTED (needs_reconfirm) and a sub-0.85 ([SENSE]) birthday are demoted out of KNOWN so hedging them is honest (no override); an off-topic omission is never flagged; a list-valued trait is never a contradiction; None/garbage evidence is tolerated and fails OPEN; the override-implies-not-ok invariant holds. Also runs anima/organs/verifier.py --selftest in-process (the organ's own isolation proof). Real .anima byte-identical before/after. scripts/certify_organ_verifier.py is the executable form.

known_gaps: The cert proves the DETERMINISTIC verifier — the whole contract and the safety-critical surface — model-free, by calling the exact production verify() the server gates on. The OPTIONAL model-assisted deeper pass (use_model=True, OFF by default and NOT on the critical path) needs a live model and is not exercised here. The downstream ENFORCEMENT ACTION in server._turn (regenerate-once-with-hard-binding, then ship the spine.answer_from_fact floor when an ignored_known_fact overrides) is driven by this verdict; the verdict + its override/issue shape that triggers it are proven here, but the regenerate leg itself runs the model and so is exercised only by the live (Ollama) Experience cert, not in this hermetic cert.
